document.about: Texas Instruments NE555 timer datasheet. Its tables and figures carry bold captions numbered by chapter (`Table 4-1. Pin Functions`, `Figure 5-1. Low-Level Output Voltage`).

notes: 2026-11-24 (#151): a bold caption was a section title on weight alone, so the text after a figure nested under its caption. Captions numbered with a hyphen by chapter were not read as captions at all.

checks.issue: The pin table's caption was a level-1 section.
Each typical-characteristics figure's caption was a section.
